top inv_tb.shbench for Ngspice
== buffer.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "unity-gain buffer around the OTA"

pin IN in -40 0
pin OUT out 40 0
pin IB in 0 40

param size 1

impl sch schematic

inst 0x0001 ./opamp
  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  wn 2*size
  wp 4*size

# Feedback by name: the inverting input carries the output label.
label 0n0001 -40 20 R0 OUT

port 0p0001 -40 -20 R0 IN
port 0p0002 40 0 R0 OUT
port 0p0003 0 40 R0 IB
== bus_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  doc "4-bit inverter array on buses"

inst 0x0001 ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name X[3:0]
  wn 0.5

wire 0w0001 -100 0 -40 0
  bus true
wire 0w0002 40 0 100 0
  bus true

label 0n0001 -100 0 R0 din[3:0]
label 0n0002 100 0 R0 dout[0:3]
== cap.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "capacitor"
  prefix C

pin P inout 0 -20
pin N inout 0 20

param C 1p
  unit F
  min 0

impl spice spice
  format spice "C{name} {P} {N} {C}"
== inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "CMOS inverter"
  category logic

pin A in -40 0
pin Y out 40 0

param wn 1
param wp 2
param l 0.15

impl sch schematic

line -40 0 -20 0
line 20 0 40 0

inst 0mn001 ./nmos
  at 0 60 R0
  name MN
  W wn
  L l
inst 0mp001 ./pmos
  at 0 -60 R0
  name MP
  W wp
  L l

# Drains joined by a vertical wire; the output wire T-joins it.
wire 0w0001 20 -30 20 30
wire 0w0002 20 0 60 0
# Gates joined; the input wire T-joins it.
wire 0w0003 -20 -60 -20 60
wire 0w0004 -60 0 -20 0

label 0n0001 20 -90 R0 vdd!
label 0n0002 20 -60 R0 vdd!
label 0n0003 20 90 R0 0
label 0n0004 20 60 R0 0

port 0p0001 -60 0 R0 A
port 0p0002 60 0 R0 Y
== inv_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  doc "inverter transient"
  corner tt

inst 0x0001 ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name X1
  wn 0.5
inst 0x0002 ./vsource
  at -200 0 R0
  name VDD
  dc vdd
inst 0x0003 ./vsource
  at -100 0 R0
  name VIN
  dc vdd/2
inst 0x0004 ./cap
  at 100 0 R0
  name CL
  C 10f

wire 0w0001 40 0 100 0
wire 0w0002 100 -20 100 0

label 0n0001 -200 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0002 -200 30 R0 0
label 0n0003 -100 -30 R0 in
label 0n0004 -100 30 R0 0
label 0n0005 -40 0 R0 in
label 0n0006 40 0 R0 out
label 0n0007 100 20 R0 0

var vdd 1.8
  unit V

corner ff
  lib models.lib ff
  set vdd 1.95
  temp -40
corner tt
  lib models.lib tt
  temp 27

code tran spice
  | .tran 1p 1n
== nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "generic NMOS"
  category nmos
  prefix M

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 1
  unit um
  min 0.42
  grid 0.01
param L 0.15
  unit um
  min 0.15
  grid 0.01
param nf 1
  kind int
  min 1
param model nfet
  kind choice
  choices nfet nfet_lvt
param ad 0
  computed W*0.29

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W={W}u L={L}u nf={nf} ad={ad}p"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W={W}u L={L}u"
== opamp.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "two-stage Miller OTA, NMOS input pair"
  category amplifier

pin INP in -40 -20
pin INN in -40 20
pin OUT out 40 0
pin IBIAS in 0 40

param wn 2
param wp 4
param l 0.5
param cc 1p

impl sch schematic

# Devices at x = 0, 100, ..., all R0. NMOS pins: D (x+20,-30) G (x-20,0) S (x+20,30)
# B (x+20,0); PMOS: S (x+20,-30) G (x-20,0) D (x+20,30) B (x+20,0).
inst 0m0001 ./nmos
  at 0 0 R0
  name M1
  W wn
  L l
inst 0m0002 ./nmos
  at 100 0 R0
  name M2
  W wn
  L l
inst 0m0003 ./pmos
  at 200 0 R0
  name M3
  W wp
  L l
inst 0m0004 ./pmos
  at 300 0 R0
  name M4
  W wp
  L l
inst 0m0005 ./nmos
  at 400 0 R0
  name M5
  W wn*2
  L l
inst 0m0006 ./pmos
  at 500 0 R0
  name M6
  W wp*4
  L l
inst 0m0007 ./nmos
  at 600 0 R0
  name M7
  W wn*2
  L l
inst 0m0008 ./nmos
  at 700 0 R0
  name M8
  W wn
  L l
inst 0c0001 ./cap
  at 800 0 R0
  name CC
  C cc

# Tail: the pair's sources share a wire.
wire 0w0001 20 30 120 30

label 0n0001 20 -30 R0 n1
label 0n0002 20 0 R0 0
label 0n0003 120 -30 R0 n2
label 0n0004 120 0 R0 0
label 0n0005 20 30 R0 tail
label 0n0006 220 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0007 180 0 R0 n1
label 0n0008 220 30 R0 n1
label 0n0009 220 0 R0 vdd!
label 0n0010 320 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0011 280 0 R0 n1
label 0n0012 320 30 R0 n2
label 0n0013 320 0 R0 vdd!
label 0n0014 420 -30 R0 tail
label 0n0015 380 0 R0 IBIAS
label 0n0016 420 30 R0 0
label 0n0017 420 0 R0 0
label 0n0018 520 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0019 480 0 R0 n2
label 0n0020 520 0 R0 vdd!
label 0n0021 620 -30 R0 OUT
label 0n0022 580 0 R0 IBIAS
label 0n0023 620 30 R0 0
label 0n0024 620 0 R0 0
label 0n0025 680 0 R0 IBIAS
label 0n0026 720 30 R0 0
label 0n0027 720 0 R0 0
label 0n0028 800 -20 R0 n2
label 0n0029 800 20 R0 OUT

port 0p0001 -20 0 R0 INP
port 0p0002 80 0 R0 INN
port 0p0003 520 30 R0 OUT
port 0p0004 720 -30 R0 IBIAS
== opamp_tb.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  doc "three buffers, two sizes: two buffer and two opamp definitions"
  corner tt

inst 0b0001 ./buffer
  at 0 0 R0
  name B1
inst 0b0002 ./buffer
  at 0 200 R0
  name B2
  size 2
inst 0b0003 ./buffer
  at 0 400 R0
  name B3
  size 1
inst 0v0001 ./vsource
  at -300 0 R0
  name VDD
  dc 1.8
inst 0v0002 ./vsource
  at -200 0 R0
  name VIN
  dc 0.9

label 0n0001 -300 -30 R0 vdd!
label 0n0002 -300 30 R0 0
label 0n0003 -200 -30 R0 in
label 0n0004 -200 30 R0 0
label 0n0005 -40 0 R0 in
label 0n0006 -40 200 R0 in
label 0n0007 -40 400 R0 in
label 0n0008 40 0 R0 o1
label 0n0009 40 200 R0 o2
label 0n0010 40 400 R0 o3
label 0n0011 0 40 R0 ib
label 0n0012 0 240 R0 ib
label 0n0013 0 440 R0 ib

corner tt
  temp 27
== pmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "generic PMOS"
  category pmos
  prefix M

pin S inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin D inout 20 30
pin B inout 20 0

param W 2
  unit um
  min 0.42
  grid 0.01
param L 0.15
  unit um
  min 0.15
  grid 0.01
param model pfet
  kind choice
  choices pfet pfet_lvt

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} W={W}u L={L}u"
== vsource.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "DC voltage source"
  prefix V

pin P inout 0 -30
pin N inout 0 30

param dc 0
  unit V

impl spice spice
  format spice "V{name} {P} {N} dc {dc}"
